entities.name: Thoughtweft
entities.description: Collective empathic web of Lorwyn kithkin magic, also called the mindweft in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: Lorwyn folk bound by the thoughtweft.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: Aspect of the plane where thoughtweft stokes paranoia.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Exploited the thoughtweft during the invasion.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian whose voice tempted the kithkin through the thoughtweft.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which kithkin used the thoughtweft as a weapon.

events.summary: Lorwyn kithkin used the thoughtweft to call reinforcements across the plane during the invasion.
events.quote: allowing villages to call for reinforcements across the plane

events.summary: The Phyrexians exploited the thoughtweft, subjecting kithkin to Elesh Norn's voice.
events.quote: the Phyrexians were able to exploit the thoughtweft

events.summary: Many kithkin cut themselves off from the thoughtweft and became nomadic.
events.quote: many kithkin cut themselves off from the thoughtweft entirely and adopted a nomadic lifestyle
